newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market firm - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were firm to $0.50 per cwt higher in a light test, compared to Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow to moderate. Demand mostly moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 67.00-68.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs 68.00-68.50.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Tuesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established with a higher undertone noted.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 109.00-110.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 103.00-104.00 ld 105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs few 107.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 103.00.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 109.00-110.00.
